headline: Regis beat Seattle Pacific again, this time away
dek: Regis won the day after Fort Lewis lost at Western Oregon, and UCCS and CSU Pueblo are now the only sides in the conference with a match still listed. CSU Pueblo take thirteen wins and one defeat into theirs, and that defeat came at home to Fort Lewis.
displaced_by: Regis and Fort Lewis have played the matches the standing dek listed; only UCCS and CSU Pueblo still have one, so the standing lines no longer hold.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: South Dakota Mines have scored more goals than Colorado School of Mines and Adams State together, but have also conceded 30; scoring is not what separates the top of the table.

wire.line: Regis have beaten Fort Lewis home and away, and have lost three times all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result published, the earliest from the season's opening day; none is a score gap.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Colorado School of Mines have yet to win this season, with three draws and fifteen defeats, the latest at home to Regis.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Adams State have scored eight goals this season and conceded 50.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Regis's Jacobo Betancourt-Tovar has scored twelve goals this season from 67 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UCCS's Hugo Sjöberg has made 68 saves this season and conceded twenty goals.

last_match.line: Regis had already beaten Seattle Pacific at home in September, and had not lost since their defeat at UCCS in October.

next_match.line: Cal State San Bernardino held Regis to a goalless draw in September; CSU Pueblo have won every home match against a non-conference side.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
